content_units: Use a   3-step filter   so you only ever choose from 1 small lane at a time:
-   Step 1: Check energy   — high, medium, or low.
-   Step 3: Check mood   —   curious  ,   stressed  ,   social  , or   mentally tired  .
Then pick from just one of these four buckets:
-   Movie   = best when you have 120 minutes and want immersion.
-   Short series   = best when you have 30–60 minutes and want momentum without a big commitment.
-   Documentary   = best when you feel curious and want something structured.
-   Comfort rewatch   = best when you are stressed or mentally drained and want low effort.
Keep one note on your phone or paper with only   8 saved options total  :
Rule: if a bucket is empty, refill it later — not during decision time.
High + Curious   Documentary episode   Short series or documentary   Movie or feature documentary
High + Social   Sitcom/short series episode   Short series, comedy special, or easy movie start   Movie
High + Stressed   Comfort rewatch episode   Comfort rewatch or light series   Familiar movie
High + Mentally tired   Comfort rewatch   Light short series   Easy familiar movie
Medium + Curious   Documentary short/episode   Documentary or short series   Movie if simple; documentary if focused
Medium + Social   Short series   Short series or familiar documentary   Crowd-pleasing movie
Medium + Stressed   Comfort rewatch   Comfort rewatch   Familiar movie or gentle documentary
Medium + Mentally tired   Comfort rewatch   Easy short series   Rewatch movie
Low + Curious   Save curiosity for tomorrow; pick a short doc only if very appealing   Gentle documentary   Only if already committed; otherwise skip
Low + Social   Easy sitcom/short episode   Familiar short series   Light familiar movie with no pressure
Low + Stressed   Comfort rewatch only   Comfort rewatch only   Rewatch movie only if it feels soothing
Low + Mentally tired   Comfort rewatch only   Comfort rewatch or stop early   Usually avoid new movies
-   Curious   → documentary first, then movie, then short series.
-   Stressed   → comfort rewatch first, then very familiar short series.
-   Social   → short series or crowd-friendly movie.
-   Mentally tired   → comfort rewatch first; avoid complex plots.
-   30 minutes   → one episode, one documentary segment, or one rewatch episode.
-   60 minutes   → two short episodes, one longer episode, or half a movie only if you’re okay splitting it.
-   120 minutes   → movie night, feature documentary, or 2–3 episodes max.
-   High energy   → okay for new stories and denser plots.
-   Low energy   → do not “try harder”; default to comfort.
Option 1:   The Rule of Three     Never browse full catalogs; at choice time, look at only 3 pre-saved titles   Lowest decision fatigue
Option 2:   One New, One Easy     Keep just 1 “new” pick and 1 “easy” pick per time slot   Balanced variety
Option 3:   Autopilot Default     If you can’t decide in 2 minutes, pick comfort rewatch automatically   Prevents spiral
Option 4:   Stop Midway on Purpose     It is valid to watch only 30–60 minutes and continue later   Reduces pressure
- Why: Minimal effort helps you recover instead of forcing a “good choice.”
- Why: You get novelty and structure without a 2-hour commitment.
- Why: Midweek is not ideal for high-stakes choices.
- Why: Easy to share, text about, or continue tomorrow.
- Why: Best night for a full-length watch with emotional bandwidth.
- Why: Weekend curiosity usually has enough attention to enjoy non-fiction.
- Why: End the week with certainty, not decision fatigue.
Decision order:   Energy → Time → Mood → Pick first match.
Fail-safe:   If no choice in 2 minutes, watch comfort rewatch.
